_comment: The Midgard node this explorer build is known to read.
nodeSchema.fingerprint covers table and column names for the relations the
read path queries, taken from NODE_TABLES in backend/src/server/probes.ts.
Regenerate it from the committed schema fixture with: ./dev compat write
backend/src/indexer/manifest.ts, which remains the value the indexer enforces.
verifiedAgainst names the deployment this build was actually run against.

midgard.commitNote: Not pinned. A branch moves, so this records which line of development the build reads and nothing about which revision anybody verified. It cannot be filled from here: the manifest carries no commit, and a local checkout is not evidence of what produced a deployment. It comes from the build record of the node being run, and `./dev doctor` warns until it does.

verifiedAgainst.note: The deployment the read path and the L1 index were exercised against.
